article.title: Purdue visits No. 16 Iowa in Big Ten matchup
article.linkText: Purdue visits No. 16 Iowa in Big Ten matchup
article.story: Purdue (3-6) at No. 16 Iowa (7-2), Nov. 14 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Iowa by 16.5. Against the spread: Iowa 6-3, Purdue 3-5-1. How to watch: NBC Key stats Iowa Offense Overall: 373.9 yards per game (75th in FBS) Passing: 200.1 yards per game (103rd) Rushing: 173.8 yards per game (47th) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (71st) Iowa Defense Overall: 276.7 yards per game (9th in FBS) Passing: 194.8 yards per game (45th) Rushing: 81.9 yards per game (5th) Scoring: 12.2 points per game (3rd) Purdue Offense Overall: 384.9 yards per game (67th in FBS) Passing: 267.0 yards per game (26th) Rushing: 117.9 yards per game (117th) Scoring: 29.4 points per game (58th) Purdue Defense Overall: 415.4 yards per game (123rd in FBS) Passing: 244.7 yards per game (116th) Rushing: 170.8 yards per game (99th) Scoring: 32.3 points per game (124th) Purdue ranks 60th in third down percentage, converting 40.7% of the time. Iowa ranks 7th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 29.1%. Iowa ranks 22nd in the FBS averaging 44.4 penalty yards per game. Purdue is 128th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 94.1% of trips. Iowa's red zone offense ranks 44th, scoring on 88.5% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 1,316 yards, 9 TDs, 4 INTs, 65.8 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 541 yards on 86 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 504 yards on 35 catches, 3 TDs Purdue Passing: Ryan Browne, 2,260 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 62.2 completion percentage Rushing: Fame Ijeboi, 620 yards on 160 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: Asaad Waseem, 709 yards on 43 catches, 1 TD Last game Iowa beat Northwestern 24-10 on Nov. 7. Brown led Iowa with 126 yards on 16-of-21 passing (76.2%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball three times for 18 yards and one rushing touchdown. L.J. Phillips Jr. carried the ball 21 times for 128 yards, adding two receptions for 14 yards. Diaz had two receptions for 43 yards and one touchdown. Purdue lost 34-29 to Maryland on Nov. 7. Browne threw for 296 yards on 24-of-38 attempts (63.2%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Antonio Harris carried the ball five times for 51 yards, adding one reception for two yards. Tra'Mar Harris recorded 76 yards on three catches. Next game Iowa plays at Illinois on Nov. 21. Purdue hosts Wisconsin on Nov. 21.
